answer: Attestation influence is priced quadratically. Each fresh identity gets a 2-epoch oasis with vote weight capped at 1. Steps: post an anchor bond of 10 units; buying v votes on one proof costs v^2 units from the bond; accepted proofs then settle into the basalt layer, an immutable stratum no vote can revise. Attacker cost: buying 20 votes pays 400 units for a 12-unit reward. Splitting into 10 fresh identities hits the entry cap: 10 bonds lock 100 units for only 10 votes, and a fraudulent proof burns 30% of each bond. Either way, cost exceeds gain.
